regexMetricSelectorOverlay.help:
## Quick Tips
Apache Lucene flavored regex is supported with the following operators.
### .
Matches any character. For example:

    ab.     # matches 'aba', 'abb', 'abz', etc.
### ? + *
Repeat the preceding character a certain number of times. For example:

    abc?     # repeat 'c' one or zero times. matches 'ab' and 'abc'
    ab+      # repeat 'b' one or more times. matches 'ab', 'abb', 'abbb', etc.
    ab*      # repeat 'b' zero or more times. matches 'a', 'ab', 'abb', 'abbb', etc.
### |
OR operator. The match will succeed if the longest pattern on either the left side OR the right side matches. For example:

    abc|xyz  # matches 'abc' and 'xyz'
### ( … )
Forms a group. You can use a group to treat part of the expression as a single character. For example:

    abc(def)?  # matches 'abc' and 'abcdef' but not 'abcd'
### [ … ]
Match one of the characters in the brackets. For example:

    [abc]   # matches 'a', 'b', 'c'
Inside the brackets, `-` indicates a range unless `-` is the first character or escaped. For example:

    [a-c]   # matches 'a', 'b', or 'c'
    [-abc]  # '-' is first character. Matches '-', 'a', 'b', or 'c'
    [abc\-] # Escapes '-'. Matches 'a', 'b', 'c', or '-'
A `^` before a character in the brackets negates the character or range. For example:

    [^abc]      # matches any character except 'a', 'b', or 'c'
    [^a-c]      # matches any character except 'a', 'b', or 'c'
    [^-abc]     # matches any character except '-', 'a', 'b', or 'c'
    [^abc\-]    # matches any character except 'a', 'b', 'c', or '-'

Note that PCRE character classes like `\w` or `\S` are not currently supported. Also note that anchor operators like `^` or `$` are not supported. The expression must match the entire string.

demo.title: Instana - Getting Started
demo.text:
Instana is the first and only fully automated Application Performance (APM) Solution designed
specifically for the challenges of managing microservice and cloud-native applications.

Getting started is easy

1. If you don't have yet access to Instana, head over to [Instana.com](https://www.instana.com) and register for a Free Trial.
2. Explore our ecosystem of hundreds of [supported technologies](https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/obi/current?topic=supported-technologies).
3. Start collecting data with one of our [agents](https://ibm.biz/installing-agent).
4. Learn [how to use Instana](https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/obi/current?topic=using-instana) for your use-cases.
5. Read about our unique [Core Capabilities](https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/obi/current?topic=core-capabilities).
6. Extend Instana with our [Integrations, SDK & APIs](https://ibm.biz/integrations-sdks-apis).

That's it!

Can't find what you're looking for? Hop over to the [documentation](https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/obi/current)!
